settings.pskEnabledHelp: Pre-shared key (PSK): In use · The existing key is preserved when saving.
settings.pskDisabledHelp: Pre-shared key (PSK): None · Not added automatically to avoid interrupting existing connections.
settings.savedSettingsHelp: Saved values take effect only after importing the configuration again on this device. After saving, download the .conf again or scan the QR again.
traffic.awaitingRate: Recent report · Speed calculated after the next report
traffic.title: Client-side traffic
traffic.reportSummary: {ageKnown, select, yes {Last report {age, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}} ago} other {No last report}} · {intervalKnown, select, yes {Agent report interval {interval, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}} other {Agent report interval unknown}} · Only handshakes within the last 120 seconds are classified as online; this does not guarantee connectivity.
traffic.countersHelp: Totals are the peer counters last reported by the gateway and may restart from 0 after a restart or reactivation. Speed is the difference between new reports.
